text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Bubble Gum Fellow
said she got invitation tickets, so we went to the
amusement park together! And then...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
――~~~~!
What was I thinking?! Getting carried away and coming to a place like this...!
Aaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy! Wow, that outfit is so cute♪
Are you meeting up with someone?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"B-Bubble-san and everyone!?
Um, well, uh... I-I'm, alone..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“N-No, that's not it!
I just completely got ahead of myself...!
When I heard about the 『Yamabuki Lantern』 collab event!”

"According to her, when she heard about a collaboration event
with her favorite fantasy novel, she couldn't sit still
and came all by herself."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Except, "it doesn't start until next week."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Dressed up so nicely, and yet I'm going to the amusement park all by myself... Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
"Bright Yellow Lantern"... huh.

It's no wonder Zenno Rob Roy is feeling down.
I want to find a way to cheer her up...
choice_data_list: W-Well, do you want to play together?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, really, I'd feel bad!
You finally have some private time with your trainee!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please don't mind me.
I'm leaving now, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, where are you planning to do the collab?
If you don't mind, show me around!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh... The location?
Rather than having me guide you,
it'd be better to check the park map...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, we'd really appreciate it if you could take us there!
We just got here and don't know our way around yet.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's so retro and atmospheric!
I had no idea there was an attraction like this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! This giant maze was originally designed with a Halloween theme, so it goes wonderfully with the exhibit...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I'm so sorry!
I ended up coming in with you...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Giggle, now that you've come this far, I'm not letting you go home, you know?
Next up is the roller coaster♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"B-Bubble-san, really...!
You honestly didn't have to..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault. Come on, chin up!
A disappointed face doesn't suit you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I declare this.
"I will make you smile!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, that was so fast.
We were spinning around, and my stomach felt totally weightless...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, truly!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...'In a storm like this, we'd go into a tailspin.
It's way easier to just hang around in the cave.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, isn't that
the Bat's line from volume 3...!?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Wait a sec...
You've read this before!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble-san, that's such an interesting interpretation!
I see, you really could look at that scene that way!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That ties right into Rob Roy's prediction from earlier, doesn't it?
Those two seem to have some hidden history between them!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Ah, now I'm looking forward
to the latest Japanese volume even more!
Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu! Ufufu!
Ah, you really put a smile on my face...!

Bubble Gum Fellow, who smoothly backed up her words with actions.
In contrast, I am...

—The next day.
I talked with Bubble Gum Fellow about yesterday.
When I praised how cool she looked...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal.
I only spoke up because I knew I could do it.
I was already familiar with that book, after all.
choice_data_list: I want to learn from that strength.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal.
I only spoke up because I knew I could do it.
I was already familiar with that book, after all.
choice_data_list: I want to learn from that strength.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Strength... huh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehe. Please, take a page from her book.
I know you can definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Though I feel a bit bad, considering it was a chance
for us to talk things over at our own pace, Trainer.
choice_data_list: No, no, I had fun too.
No, no, I had fun too

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, let me make it up to you next time, okay?
Our time together alone is important too, so it's a promise.
